concepts.def: Atmosphere absorbs IR re-emitted by Earth

walkthroughs.body_html:
Sun emits short-wave radiation that warms Earth.

Earth emits infrared; CO2, CH4, H2O absorb it.

Re-emission warms the atmosphere.

Ice cores match temperature and CO2 trends.

The IPCC reviews thousands of studies and concludes warming is human-caused.

Hydrogen: clean burn but expensive.

Biofuels: carbon neutral in theory but use land.

Fossil fuels: high energy but high CO2.
